The '''Giju system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Herglic Space/Legends|Herglic Space]] within the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giju/Legends|Giju]].
